description: This source file defines a SwiftUI View called CostUsageHistoryMenuView, which displays cost usage summaries, including a header with today's and total costs, a chart visualization of daily costs, and a footer indicating missing data entries. It also includes a helper enum for date parsing and formatting.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses a date string in 'yyyy-MM-dd' format into a Date object.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Formats a Date object into a string with 'yyyy-MM-dd' format.
